name: What should I prepare before a half-bath remodel begins?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a half-bath remodel begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your half-bath remodel starts, it's helpful to clear out personal items from the space, remove any wall decor, and ensure easy access for our team. You should also finalize all material selections, such as fixtures, tiles, and paint colors, to avoid project delays. Having a clear idea of your design preferences and sharing any specific concerns with our project manager helps streamline the process and ensures we can complete your remodel efficiently and to your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before remodeling, clear the space, remove decor, and finalize all material selections. Share design preferences and concerns with your project manager for a smooth process.
